evidence: The official Services page text lists Department Wise, Service wise and Category wise views, a Search control and many department links.
user_impact: Visitors who do not know which department owns a service may take longer to find the right destination.
recommended_fix: Check that each view is clearly named, the search field has a programmatic label, and changed results are announced.

evidence: The Home page text snapshot lists text-to-speech, text size, line height, link highlighting, text spacing, cursor and colour/theme controls. The official FAQ also describes font and contrast options.
user_impact: Visitors who rely on these options may not be able to use them if their names, states or keyboard behaviour are unclear.
recommended_fix: Verify accessible names, roles, state changes, keyboard activation and the Reset All Settings action.

evidence: The Home page text snapshot includes a Skip To Main Content link. The hosted Chromium run could not reach the page to test its target or focus movement.
user_impact: A skip link that does not move focus correctly may not help keyboard users bypass repeated navigation.
recommended_fix: Activate the link with Enter and confirm focus moves to the main content, not only the scroll position.
